name: Omawari Kunisaburou
source:
"What do you need to care about other than us?"

Occupation: Police Officer

Fear! Sociopathic Police Officer

A police officer who works right in the middle of the city, in a very unsafe area called New Town. He has a good reputation among people for his good looks and fresh attitude, but his colleagues have a completely different impression on him, finding him creepy. He has a friendly demeanor, but basically has no interest in people and his emotions never waver, no matter what. While he is not good at reading emotions, he's very insightful, but his dissimilarities gradually come to light after being in contact with him for a while, and the relationship starts changing dramatically.

   He is confident in himself, has no complexes, and is extremely versatile, but in other words he is unable to do one thing for a long time.

   In meeting you, he feels a slight change in his old self, and for the first time in his life, becomes someone who's interested in another person.
